scenario: The ego car initiates a right lane change but aborts and returns to its original lane, while an adversarial car follows straight in the adjacent right lane.

ego.behavior: The car steers toward the right lane but then veers back into its original path to perform an aborted lane change.

adversarials.behavior: The car moves straight ahead in the adjacent right lane behind the ego vehicle.

spatial_relation: On a multi-lane straight road, the ego car is positioned in the left lane with an adversarial car traveling in the right lane directly behind and to the right of the ego.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must maintain initial spacing from the adversarial car behind it in the adjacent lane; the scenario terminates after the ego completes its aborted lane change maneuver.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the car performing the lane change; one adversarial car follows behind. 2. Enumeration: one adversarial car. 3. Chronology: initial ego in left lane, adversarial in right lane behind; midpoint ego steers right then aborts; ending ego returns to original lane, adversarial continues straight. 4. Evidence: ego's lateral position shifts right then back; adversarial maintains constant forward vector in right lane.
